record.name: Funded commit/reveal auction
record.summary: Allocate funded sale lots at a uniform clearing price, refund unused bids, then open ordinary pool trading.

units.amounts: Raw currency/token units; no display/value conversion
units.liquidity: Actual core L, not token balances or economic value
units.time: Absolute UTC seconds; inclusive starts and exclusive sale/commit/reveal ends
units.identity: Maker/holder/bidder/router identity is exactly the source-defined account, not inferred human diversity

fields.name: currency0
fields.label: Currency0
fields.help: The lower address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: currency1
fields.label: Currency1
fields.help: The higher address in the actual ordered plain ERC20 pair.

fields.name: sqrtPriceX96
fields.label: Initial pool sqrt price
fields.units: Q64.96 sqrt(raw currency1/currency0); not a display-token price
fields.help: Review both token decimals and initial pool price. Opening/auction prices do not set or move this AMM price.

fields.name: saleIsCurrency0
fields.label: Sell currency0
fields.units: explicit sale side in the ordered currency pair
fields.help: True sells currency0 for currency1; false sells currency1 for currency0. All amounts use the selected raw-token units, not display-token prices.

fields.name: lotSize
fields.label: Sale units per lot
fields.units: raw sale-token units in one indivisible lot

fields.name: proceedsRecipient

fields.help: Fixed quote recipient; may differ from the inventory funder.

fields.name: unsoldRecipient

fields.help: Fixed sale-token recipient; funding is an irrevocable gift to this program.

liveChecks.requirement: Verify current deployed plain ERC20 code, raw decimals and exact debit/credit behavior. Native, tax, rebase, restricted and dishonest assets are unsupported.

Recheck against the actual construction block timestamp; saved schedules may expire before deployment.
Recipient must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero validation alone is insufficient.
Recipient must differ from the predicted hook address; nonzero validation alone is insufficient.

Verify requiredInventory=lotSize*supplyLots and full exact funding strictly before commitStart. Funding is irrevocable and gives its funder no personal withdrawal right. Direct transfers create no bid or inventory credit.

Bids use explicit commitBid/revealBid methods and actual msg.sender deposits, never an immediate-output swap. Bind domain/chain/hook/manager/full pool/terms/owner/nonce/deposit/price/lots/salt. Reveal must be submitted by the recorded bid owner; no delegated reveal or automatic reveal is supplied.

Check live commit/reveal windows and the global64-commitment capacity. At/after revealEnd, permissionless settlement is required to open swaps; claims never expire. Opening does not seed, initialize or reprice the later AMM: liquidity, initial price, ordinary fee and a usable route require separate review.
Confirm the fixed proceeds/unsold recipients can receive and use the selected plain assets, including any contract custody policy. Payout triggers cannot redirect them.

definition.help: Lots are indivisible raw sale-token amounts; prices/deposits are raw quote-token units. Demand at or below supply pays reserve; excess demand pays the marginal winning price. Marginal lots use largest fractional remainders, with earlier commitments breaking ties. Unrevealed and losing deposits refund without forfeiture. Sale/refund claims pay the recorded bidder; proceeds/unsold pay fixed recipients, indefinitely. Anyone can fill 64 refundable slots; bid splitting and withholding can affect allocations. No private orderflow, anti-Sybil or fairness guarantee. Swaps remain gated until explicit settlement; LP operations remain available throughout.
